items.title: We got a first look at Samsung Intelligent Eyewear, the smart glasses entering a fraught market worried about privacy
items.excerpt: Samsung's display-less Intelligent Eyewear runs on the Snapdragon AR1 platform with an on-device Hexagon NPU, offering Gemini-powered visual search and real-time translation as Samsung takes on Meta in AI smart glasses.

items.title: Samsung just revealed more details about its upcoming smart glasses, including battery life
items.excerpt: Samsung detailed specs for its Snapdragon AR1 Gen 1 smart glasses — nine hours of battery per charge plus a charging case for seven more — with the Hexagon NPU handling on-device AI tasks like visual search and translation.

items.title: Samsung's answer to Meta's Ray-Bans is (almost) here, with a little help from Google
items.excerpt: Samsung's Gemini-powered smart glasses run Android XR with live translation, navigation and a camera that feeds Gemini Live so the assistant can describe what you're looking at — its clearest rival yet to Ray-Ban Meta.

items.title: Samsung Let Me Touch Its Warby Parker x Gentle Monster Smart Glasses, but Not Wear Them
items.excerpt: A hands-on with Samsung's fashion-forward Android XR glasses made with Warby Parker and Gentle Monster, running Gemini-powered features like live translation and camera-based visual assistance.

items.title: Leak reveals what to expect from Samsung's smart glasses at Unpacked tomorrow
items.excerpt: A pre-Unpacked leak details Samsung's Gemini-powered AI glasses, spelling out the on-device AI capabilities, camera and battery expectations ahead of the official reveal.

items.title: Samsung and Google are betting they can avoid Meta's 'perv glasses' problem
items.excerpt: Analysis of how Samsung and Google are positioning their Gemini-powered Android XR smart glasses to dodge the privacy backlash that has dogged Meta's camera-equipped Ray-Bans.

items.title: The Galaxy Z Fold 8 is wider, lighter, and ready to fight the iPhone Ultra
items.excerpt: Samsung's Galaxy Z Fold 8 packs a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 for Galaxy chip and a Galaxy AI suite with a Gemini Intelligence task-automation tool spanning 40+ apps for on-device agentic actions.

items.title: Samsung's slimmer Galaxy Z Flip 8 brings apps and AI to the cover screen
items.excerpt: The Galaxy Z Flip 8 pushes Galaxy AI and full apps onto its expanded cover display, letting Gemini-powered features run without opening the phone.

items.title: Meta Glasses review: A bit less polish, a lot more baggage
items.excerpt: Meta's new $299 branded AI glasses deliver the same Meta AI voice assistant and camera features as pricier Ray-Ban models, testing whether cheaper hardware can push AI eyewear mainstream.

items.title: An Unholy Union of Smart Glasses and Wireless Earbuds Is Upon Us
items.excerpt: A new category of camera-equipped wireless earbuds with onboard AI is emerging, letting wearers ask an AI model about what's in front of them without pulling out a phone — earbuds edging into smart-glasses territory.

items.title: Samsung Galaxy Unpacked July 2026: Live updates from the Z Fold 8, Flip 8, glasses and watches
items.excerpt: Live coverage of Samsung's Unpacked, where the company unveiled Gemini-powered Galaxy Glasses alongside the Z Fold 8, Z Flip 8 and new Galaxy AI features across its device lineup.

items.title: Samsung Galaxy Unpacked 2026 live — Z Fold 8, Flip 8 and Galaxy Glasses
items.excerpt: TechRadar's live blog of Samsung Unpacked, covering the reveal of the Gemini-powered Intelligent Eyewear and the Galaxy AI capabilities baked into the new foldables and watches.
